title: Instrument registry: ASD LabSpec 4 classes and serial presets
description: The user's Standard / High-res switch decides the class (DECISIONS 50). This registry only PRESETS the switch for a new folder when a file's serial is listed, and lets the app show a gentle note when a file's serial is known to be the other class. The switch always wins. Unknown serials: the header's SWIR detector gains may preset it instead (header_hint; a heuristic), else the switch keeps its current (or default) position. Exports record the class and whether the user set it or a serial preset it. Per-unit details (per-lab transfer files) come later with the calibration kit.

switch.mismatch_note: This file's instrument (serial {serial}) is listed as {other}. Results use the {current} setting; change the switch if that is wrong.

provenance.serials: units whose files were used in development; no lab or owner is named
provenance.header_hint: SWIR1 and SWIR2 gains (header bytes 436/438) across 681 distinct files from all five units: standard 284-694 (three units, 2014-2026), high-res 16-21 (two units, 2025-2026). Ranges are padded; both gains must agree. Five units only: a hint, never a rule.
